Usage:
  cloudlist [flags]

CONFIGURATION:

   -pc, -provider-config string  provider config file (default "/home/ctk/.config/cloudlist/provider-config.yaml")

   -s, -service string[]           query and display results from given service (comma-separated) (default app,appservice,domain,route53,apigateway,alb,lightsail,deployments,loadbalancer,ingress,s3,lambda,containerapps,staticwebapps,nomad,eks,droplet,dns,cloud-function,trafficmanager,aks,service,custom,elb,domains,compute,cloud-run,containerinstances,apimanagement,ecs,cdn,storage,frontdoor,instance,gke,vm,functions,fastly,publicip,applicationgateway,consul,ec2,apigatewayv2,cloudfront)

UPDATE:
   -up, -update                 update cloudlist to latest version
   -duc, -disable-update-check  disable automatic cloudlist update check

OUTPUT:
   -o, -output string  output file to write results
   -json               write output in json format
   -version            display version of cloudlist
